# S14 — Port the TUI to Charm v2

Move internal/tui and cmd/ork from the github.com/charmbracelet v1 modules
to charm.land v2 (bubbletea, lipgloss, bubbles) before S12 adds screens
(`stack.charm-major`).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:** new screens, behavior changes, or any other dependency.

all of them.
